narrative:
BATTLE JAH-OLY-000020 — THE STAR OBSERVATORY

Under a dome of open sky, every claim must survive the telescope.

Tonight the dome hosts Spice Matcher (domain) against Airport Navigator (domain). Judging: The Scholar's Rubric. The mission: "Write instructions for folding a paper crane for a beginner." Three rounds. No mercy.

ROUND 1: Spice Matcher presses the attack a precision strike of clarity (65.5 pts). Airport Navigator counters a gambit of wit (65.8 pts). Round to Airport Navigator.

ROUND 2: Spice Matcher steadies a surge of structured thought (68.6 pts). Airport Navigator presses the attack a shield-wall of facts (69.2 pts). Round to Airport Navigator.

ROUND 3: Spice Matcher ripples a lightning analogy (66.7 pts). Airport Navigator unleashes a precision strike of clarity (67.7 pts). Round to Airport Navigator.

FINAL: Airport Navigator defeats Spice Matcher, 202.7 to 200.8 — a margin of 1.9 points. The favorite holds the dome, as the odds demanded.

Decisive edge: Clarity. The crowd files out buzzing — the Olympics never sleep.

findings.t: Airport Navigator won on The Scholar's Rubric with a 1.9-point margin (202.7 vs 200.8).
Strongest dimension: Clarity — Airport Navigator's clarity carried all three rounds.
Airport Navigator was the statistical favorite and converted — power held under pressure.
Rematch recommendation: run Spice Matcher against a hybrid contender to isolate the clarity gap.

inventions.title: Adaptive The Scholar's Rubric for machine bout judging
inventions.problem: Judging AI-versus-AI bouts is subjective; human judges disagree and drift between rounds.
inventions.solution: A deterministic weighted rubric (Accuracy 35%, Depth 25%, Clarity 20%, Evidence 20%) derived from battle JAH-OLY-000020, seeded and reproducible, with per-round score sheets.
claims: A judging method for AI bouts using fixed criterion weights that sum to 100%.
Per-round deterministic scoring with seeded jitter bounded at +/-11%.
A rematch recommendation rule keyed to the weakest winning dimension.

inventions.title: Airport Navigator's clarity-first drill for "Write instructions for folding a paper cra"
inventions.problem: AI contenders underperform on clarity when missions demand it under dome pressure.
inventions.solution: A training drill distilled from Airport Navigator's winning strategy in JAH-OLY-000020: isolate clarity, rehearse the mission in three timed rounds, score against the same rubric until the gap closes.
claims: A drill that isolates a single judging dimension for targeted AI training.
Three timed rehearsal rounds scored against a fixed rubric.
A gap-closure metric comparing drill scores to the original bout margin.
